description: Engine setup of map7_s03 (Nowhere - final boss), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type ER2, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: Incubus, Unknown23, Cybil, EndingCybil, Dahlia, EndingDahlia, BloodyLisa, Alessa, Incubator, BloodyIncubator, Kaufmann, EndingKaufmann and LittleIncubus). "character_effects": Incubus and Unknown23 draw their own effects here: the final bosses' lightning, fire, sparks and light beams. The sh.map lightning, fire and beam binds and the bosses' sh.entity effect binds work only on a map that lists Incubus, the shock sparks of Unknown23 only where Unknown23 is listed. A mod changes it with its own maps/map7_s03/overlay.json.
